blendVariants.label: Maduro
blendVariants.title: Undercrown Maduro Corona Viva
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Cocoa, espresso, black pepper, earth and dark fruit sweetness make the Maduro the rounder, sweeter side of the Undercrown family. A Mexican San Andrés Otapan Negro wrapper sits over a Connecticut River Valley stalk-cut habano binder with Brazilian Mata Fina and Nicaraguan filler, which gives it more chocolate and less of the pepper spike that defines Undercrown 10.
blendVariants.noteHtml: At 5⅝″ × 46 the Maduro Corona Viva is a longer and slightly wider cigar than the Undercrown 10 that shares its name.
